Philip Morris International’s U.S. businesses (PMI U.S.) are invested in America’s future as we advance boldly into its next 250 years. strengthening communities

We’re investing in the heartland of America, with a major expansion in Owensboro, Kentucky, and a brand-new facility in Aurora, Colorado. ## About

Philip Morris International (PMI) is a leading international consumer goods company working to deliver a smoke-free future and evolving its portfolio for the long term to include products outside of the tobacco and nicotine sector. As of H1 2026, PMI's smoke-free products were available for sale in 109 markets and smoke-free products accounted for approximately 42% of net revenues. With a strong foundation and significant expertise in life sciences, PMI announced in February 2021 its ambition to expand into wellness and healthcare areas and aims to enhance life through the delivery of seamless health experiences. For more information, please visit www.pmi.com and www.pmiscience.com.

Our priority is to attract, support and keep with us diverse and unique individuals. Our global workforce of more than 69,000 people is one of our greatest strengths and the key to our success as a company. Our employees speak more than 80 languages and come from all corners of the world. PMI has also been certified as a “Global Top Employer” for the seventh consecutive year, in recognition of the high standards of excellence in our working environment and the exceptional development opportunities we offer.
